test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: ((a-b+c)²-(a-b-c)²)/(b-a) is equal to
solution:
**Concept -**

a² - b² = (a - b)(a + b)

**Explanation -**

We have ((a-b+c)²-(a-b-c)²)/(b-a)

= ((a-b+c-(a-b-c))(a-b+c+(a-b-c)))/(b-a)

= ((a-b+c-a+b+c)(a-b+c+a-b-c))/(b-a)

= ((c+c)(a-b+a-b))/(b-a)

= ((2c)(2a-2b))/(b-a) = ((2c)times -2(b-a))/(b-a) = -4c

**Hence Option (1) is correct.**
